search_incident_reports.description: - search_incident_reports — Search incident reports for a reservation.

issue_compensation.description: - issue_compensation — Issue compensation for a documented incident.

transfer_to_human_agents.description: - transfer_to_human_agents — Transfer the user to a human agent, with a summary of the user's issue.
